text.p: Portuguese bonds consolidated slightly above Monday's closing levels and dealers expected the Treasury's three-year bond auction to lend support to the whole yield curve.

"There are no indicators today and that will limit volatility but financial investors are buying longer maturities which is keeping them buoyant. We'll have to see how the auction turns out," said one trader.
Dealers expect bids at around secondary market levels which would help narrow 10-year spreads against Bunds and Bonos. The auction result is due at 1000 GMT.
The escudo slipped against the mark to trade at around 101.50 per mark after closing at 100.94/97.
Dealers said downside was limited by fears that the Bank of Portugal would intervene and there was good support at 101.15.
